summary.account: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm
summary.confidence_reason: Low because the $4490 increase needs more than the $2380 of planned budget headroom (readiness 3.5/5 would otherwise give Medium). Google's simulation and recommended budget support about $5540 a month of extra spend at a marginal CPA at or under $40, but the plan funds only $2380, the impression-share bound, because the two sources disagree by more than 2x. The other $2110 depends on new keywords and a test that have no history yet.
summary.headline: About $7890 a month is reachable on the evidence; $10,000 is reachable on paper if the expansion holds a $40 CPA. Fix the double-counted calls first.

requirements.number: 5 counted actions; 1 lead action counts every conversion per click
requirements.why: Auto-tagging is on. The imported phone call action counts MANY_PER_CLICK, and 3 counted actions record calls side by side (Calls from ads, Phone Call (imported), Call or text), so one caller can be counted more than once. Smart Bidding would chase the duplicates as budgets rise.

requirements.number: 30-day CPA $30 = 74% of the $40 max; last 3 months' CPA 28% above the 3 before
requirements.why: The level leaves a 26% buffer, but CPA climbed from $23 (Apr-Jun) to $30 (Jul-Sep) on flat spend, which is more than the 20% the pass line allows.
Well above 30, so Smart Bidding has signal at the account level.

requirements.number: top non-brand campaign holds 37% of non-brand conversions
requirements.why: Brand runs in its own campaign, and the largest non-brand campaign (Criminal Defense) is under the 60% line.

requirements.number: 1 page with 19% of landing-page spend converts at 10.0% vs 18.7% account rate
requirements.why: The drug charges page converts at under two thirds of the account's landing-page rate. Pages converting under half the rate take 1% of landing-page spend, under the 25% fail line. Coverage: landing pages carry 62% of all conversions; calls from ads have no page.

readiness.verdict: Fix the gaps in phase 1, and raise budgets only on campaigns that qualify as Scale now.

current_performance.reading: Spend has been flat for 6 months while CPA rose by half: the account is buying fewer leads for the same money before any scaling.

roadmap.name: Fix the base, then feed the cheapest headroom
roadmap.objective: Remove the double-counted call conversions and put the first step into the campaign whose next conversions are cheapest.
actions: Week 1: make the imported phone call action count one conversion per click, and keep only one of the counted call actions as primary (the others observed), before any budget moves.
Raise Criminal Defense as shown; leave every other budget as it is.
Drug Charges: rework the drug charges landing page and check which search terms the spend now buys; no budget change.
DUI: 54% of impression share is lost to rank, so work on bids and Quality Score; no budget change.
Nursing Board: review the 3 conversions and the search terms before spending more.
success_criteria: this phase's marginal CPA at or under $40 (planned $21)
risk_responses: If weekly CPA tops $40 two weeks running: return the step's budgets to their start values and hold.
If conversions rise less than half as fast as spend: stop adding and check search terms for new waste.

actions: Raise Criminal Defense, Traffic Tickets as shown.

roadmap.name: Widen the keyword base
roadmap.objective: Add proven search terms and tested new keywords, because the budget headroom at or under $40 is used up.
actions: No Keyword Planner idea is affordable at a $10 CPC; test the 12 stretch ideas in their own ad group, watched at a $40 CPA.
At most one campaign-type test (for example a Dynamic Search Ads campaign on the site's practice pages), capped at $950 a month with a pass line of CPA under $40 after 4 weeks.
Re-check Fix first campaigns: any that held CPA under $40 for this phase can take budget in the next one.

risk_responses: If weekly CPA tops $40 two weeks running: return the step's budgets to their start values and hold.

roadmap.name: Reach the target
roadmap.objective: Scale what passed in the expansion phase up to the $10,000 target.
actions: Put the step into the expansion keywords and the test that held CPA under $40 in the last phase.
If nothing passed, stop at the previous phase's spend: the target isn't reachable at $40 yet.
Re-check the Fix first campaigns; one that held under $40 for a full phase can take part of this step.
